meta.name: company-events
meta.description: Company event signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about M&A signals, company expansion, new locations, IPO, product launches, leadership changes, headquarters moves, mergers, acquisitions, or firmographic triggers. Do NOT use for funding rounds (use funding skill) or hiring signals (use hiring skill).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪公司事件信号，发现 B2B 销售机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要监控目标公司的并购、扩张、领导层变更等信号来驱动销售。
copy.tagline_en: Track company event signals to uncover B2B sales opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor M&A, expansion, leadership changes, etc., to drive sales.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你追踪公司的事件信号，比如并购、扩张、新产品发布、领导层变动等，并评估这些事件带来的销售机会。
howto.when: 当你询问某公司的并购、扩张、IPO、产品发布、领导层变动、总部搬迁等组织变更事件时触发。不用于融资或招聘信号。

say.text: 帮我看看这家公司最近有没有并购事件？
say.note: Claude 会查询并返回并购相关的信号和评分。

say.text: 监控我目标市场中的公司扩张动态。
say.note: Claude 会设置监控并提醒新地点等信号。

say.text: 一家公司刚开了欧洲新办公室，该怎么跟进？
say.note: Claude 会提供跟进策略和打分。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to track company event signals such as M&A, expansion, product launches, leadership changes, etc., and score their sales opportunities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about M&A, expansion, IPO, product launch, leadership change, HQ move, or other organizational change events. Not for funding or hiring signals.

say_en.text: Check if this company had any M&A events recently?
say_en.note: Claude will return M&A signals and scores.

say_en.text: Monitor company expansion moves in my target market.
say_en.note: Claude will set up alerts for new locations etc.

say_en.text: A company just opened a new office in Europe, how to follow up?
say_en.note: Claude will provide outreach strategy and scoring.
